dog.description_text: Meet Nala — New Arrival! Nala just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQDv_R-PDedfR7Yvh-A7qCjQAYNSusD0rsBIgO1Nqt8TQco?e=QgyEes Her foster says "She’s a total sweetheart and very easygoing. She is affectionate, but also likes her alone time. She loves scratches under her chin and will melt into your hand.Nala was very affectionate for the first 24 hours, always sitting on my lap and wanting to be pet. She became more independent over time (48 hours in). Nala is a big couch potato, sleeping most of the day. She doesn’t like to be picked up but will sit on your lap and sleep next to you in bed. Loves scratches under her chin and laying on the heating pad. She’s very affectionate, sweet, easygoing and just wants to lay on my chest all day.". She is spayed , vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
